Why dance with us?

A level for everybody

Taking your first Kizomba steps or ready to build on the basics? Find a class that suits where you are and gives you room to grow.

Find your tribe

Come solo or bring a friend. Between the class and the social, there’s plenty of time to meet people, share a dance and find familiar faces to come back to.

Great music

Discover the music that makes us want to dance, from the smooth rhythms of Kizomba to the playful energy of Semba. With some of the best DJs in London, you might even leave with a new favourite track.

Build your confidence

Get comfortable with the rhythm, practice dancing with different partners and take what you’ve learnt straight onto the social dance floor.
